ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (26) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form); blocks 2, 3 had no website counterpart and were translated fresh.

«Вера» (vera) is 'faith' and «ложная вера» (lozhnaya vera) 'false faith' throughout; Lessing's «церковность» (tserkovnost') is 'churchliness'. The opening thought and its second paragraph, which the website lacked, are translated fresh; the periodical «Передовая мысль мира» (Peredovaya mysl' mira) is The World's Advance Thought.
